formula.ascii: p is a summit iff it is the strict maximum of its metric disc (ties: lowest row-major index wins) and drop(p) = h(p) - max(h(q)) over the disc ring >= minimumDrop; the disc is ((dx*cx)^2 + (dy*cy)^2) <= radius^2 at the centre row; reject policy: a disc leaving the grid or touching nodata is no summit; drop is +Infinity with an empty ring; NaN where there is no summit
